headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.31
summary: The Xbox Friends screen gets a proper card layout, an All/Online/Offline filter and a search field that filters your friend list instead of opening a dialog, while the Requests tab searches the Xbox directory inline. This release also takes upstream's mod menu and launcher runtime overhead work, so the in-game HUD and the logcat overlay cost less per frame.

items.text: The friends and requests lists now sit inside a rounded card with a subtle outline, which reads as a card in light, dark and AMOLED themes instead of blending into the page.

A new All / Online / Offline filter above the list uses the same segmented control as the instances, mods and installed-package screens, so filtering friends behaves like filtering anywhere else in the launcher. It hides itself on the Requests tab, where the split does not apply.

The add-friend button is now a search field. On the Friends tab it filters the list you already have as you type, and it stacks with the Online/Offline filter; on the Requests tab it searches the Xbox directory and renders the results right in the card, so adding someone new no longer needs a dialog.
Empty states now tell the three cases apart: no friends at all, nobody matching the current filter, and no gamertag matching the search.

Merged upstream's runtime overhead work for the mod menu, HUD overlays and logcat overlay: overlay updates are throttled through a single handler instead of being recomputed on every tick, the logcat reader invalidates stale streams, and activity references are held weakly. The fork's three-tick visibility debounce stays, so the MIUI overlay freeze fix is untouched.
Vietnamese strings for the new friend search prompt, the friend-list search hint and both new empty states.
